newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO says hopes to cut rates early next year.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO says hopes to cut rates early next year.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc president Hiroshi Araki told a news conference on Friday that he hopes to be able to cut electricity rates some time early next year.

Araki spoke ahead of the release later this month of a government-drafted action programme that is expected to urge power utilities to take steps to lower electricity rates and introduce more competition in the sector.
Japan's ten leading private power companies currently enjoy regional monopolies.

Earlier this month, Japan's Fair Trade Commission (FTC) issued a report promoting the division of electric power utilities into producers and distributors, in order to make room for new players in the industry.
